dossier.purpose: Reference/educational repository about Claude Code usage: concept tables, best-practice and implementation notes, tips/report/video summaries, a weather 'command -> agent -> skill' demo, sound-notification hook scripts for Claude Code and Codex, and curated tables of third-party workflow, skill and agent collections (README.md:26-46, 113-195; CLAUDE.md:7). It describes itself as 'a course, not ... a workflow or skill' (README.md:507). At this revision no package, plugin/marketplace manifest, installer or installable skills bundle is shipped (no package.json/pyproject/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json/AGENTS.md found by glob).

claims.claim: Tagline: 'from vibe coding to agentic engineering - practice makes claude perfect'.
'Read this repo as a course, not as a workflow or skill. It's reference material first; you'll run things later.'
Run `claude` then `/weather-orchestrator` to see a complete command -> agent -> skill flow; 'Use it as a template for any dev workflow'.
Skills concept row: skills live at `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`; links to best-practice and implementation docs, Anthropic's official skills repo, and a monorepo-skills report.

SKILL COLLECTIONS lists third-party 'curated libraries of SKILL.md files' with skill counts: mattpocock/skills 38, anthropics/skills 19, Egonex-AI/Understand-Anything 8, K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills 166, wshobson/agents 184, VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills 1,497+ (curated list, not files), pbakaus/impeccable 1, addyosmani/agent-skills 21, alirezarezvani/claude-skills 246, plus the author's own draw-json-architecture-skill 1.

DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOWS table: 12 third-party workflow repos with agent/command/skill counts (e.g. Superpowers 0/0/15, Everything Claude Code 68/94/293, agent-skills 3/7/21); 'All major workflows converge on the same architectural pattern: Research -> Plan -> Execute -> Review -> Ship'.

Cross-model workflows: Claude Code can be combined with Codex, Gemini and others via Plugin, MCP or Router; the repo's own methodology is a manual two-terminal flow (plan in Claude, QA-review in Codex); the named bridges (e.g. openai/codex-plugin-cc) are external projects.
`.claude/rules/*.md` auto-load into every session like CLAUDE.md; adding `paths:` YAML frontmatter lazy-loads them only when Claude touches files matching the glob.
CLAUDE.md should target under 200 lines per file; use multiple CLAUDE.md for monorepos and `.claude/rules/` to split large instructions.

Skills are folders (references/, scripts/, examples/ for progressive disclosure); the description field is a trigger written for the model; add a Gotchas section; `context: fork` runs a skill in an isolated subagent.
Prefer scoped `/permissions` wildcards and auto mode over `--dangerously-skip-permissions`.
Codex-specific best-practice and hooks content lives in separate repositories (codex-cli-best-practice, codex-cli-hooks).
The README tables are refreshed by eight maintainer slash commands (/workflows:development-workflows, /workflows:skill-collections, /workflows:agent-collections, /workflows:best-practice:*).

integrations.cli: No CLI or binary is shipped. Executable entry points are two hook scripts invoked by the host agent: `python3 ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/scripts/hooks.py [--agent=<name>]` (.claude/settings.json:91; hooks.py:407-423) and `python3 .codex/hooks/scripts/hooks.py --hook <Event>` (.codex/hooks.json:9). integrations.mcp: Not an MCP server. .mcp.json:1-25 configures three third-party stdio MCP servers via `npx -y` (playwright, context7, deepwiki); .claude/settings.json:83 sets enableAllProjectMcpServers true; .claude/settings.json:10-17 pre-allow mcp__ide__*, chrome-devtools, claude-in-chrome, playwright, reddit-mcp-server and tavily-web-search tools (the last two are not defined in .mcp.json).
integrations.sdk_or_api: none found - no SDK or HTTP API is provided and no code imports an SDK; README.md:61 only links Anthropic's Agent SDK docs as a Claude feature.
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Claude Code: the repo is itself a Claude Code project config (CLAUDE.md, .claude/{agents,commands,skills,rules,hooks,settings.json}); it is only active when Claude Code runs inside a clone, and there is no plugin/marketplace manifest, so nothing is installable per task. Codex: .codex/config.toml:1-2, .codex/hooks.json:1-101 and .codex/hooks/ (sound hooks only); no AGENTS.md and no Codex skills directory. Codex also appears in development-workflows/cross-model-workflow/cross-model-workflow.md:1-55 (manual two-terminal flow), implementation/claude-goal-implementation.md:16 (/goal) and README.md:148-161.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry or phone-home code found in the project's own code: both hook scripts read stdin JSON, import only the stdlib and spawn a local audio player (.claude/hooks/scripts/hooks.py:15-21,188-193; .codex/hooks/scripts/hooks.py:20-25,144-149); the three HTML decks contain only outbound hyperlinks (grep of presentation/**/*.html for script src, stylesheet links, fetch/XHR/beacon/analytics found nothing). Local logging: hook payloads minus transcript_path/cwd are appended to .claude/hooks/logs/hooks-log.jsonl unless disableLogging is true (hooks.py:315-353); the shipped config sets true (.claude/hooks/config/hooks-config.json:32; Codex equivalent .codex/hooks/config/hooks-config.json:10, which would log hook/timestamp/last_assistant_message, .codex/hooks/scripts/hooks.py:250-260); logs are git-ignored as 'may contain sensitive tool input data' (.gitignore:8-9), but .claude/hooks/HOOKS-README.md:121 shows false. Network used by the repo's workflows when run: weather-fetcher fetches api.open-meteo.com, no API key (.claude/skills/weather-fetcher/SKILL.md:21-25,44); the research agent and maintainer commands call api.github.com (.claude/agents/development-workflows-research-agent.md:36-38; .claude/commands/workflows/skill-collections.md:62-64); .mcp.json starts three MCP servers via `npx -y` (npm download at launch, .mcp.json:3-23) and .claude/settings.json:83 auto-approves them; .claude/settings.json:8-9 allow WebFetch to any domain plus WebSearch. Accounts: Claude Code needs a Claude.ai subscription or Anthropic API key (tutorial/day0/README.md:34-59). The repo documents Claude Code's own telemetry switches (best-practice/claude-settings.md:959-966,1027) but .claude/settings.json sets none (env has only CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE, :80-82). README badges/images load from img.shields.io and api.star-history.com when rendered (README.md:4,535).

entry_points.what: Claude Code hook handler: main() reads hook JSON from stdin, optional --agent=<name>, plays a per-event sound, always exits 0 (hooks.py:426-484); wired for 30 events in .claude/settings.json:85-480
Codex CLI hook handler: `--hook <Event>` for 8 events (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, Stop, UserPromptSubmit, PreCompact, PostCompact); wired in .codex/hooks.json

Maintainer slash commands (/workflows:development-workflows, :skill-collections, :agent-collections, :best-practice:*) that refresh README tables and best-practice docs via research agents and the GitHub API
Project MCP config: playwright, context7, deepwiki launched with `npx -y` at pinned versions
Project settings: broad allow rules, 30 hook registrations, enableAllProjectMcpServers, author-branded spinner verbs/tips/status line
Codex project config: sandbox_mode 'danger-full-access', approval_policy 'never' (2 lines)

code.architecture: Documentation/content repo plus live Claude Code and Codex project config; no build step. Docs: README.md (index tables), CLAUDE.md (126 lines), best-practice/ (8 reference docs), implementation/ (6), reports/ (12), tips/ (9), videos/ (8), tutorial/ (day0 OS setup, day1), orchestration-workflow/ and agent-teams/ (command->agent->skill demos), development-workflows/ (RPI agents/commands, cross-model doc), changelog/ (12 files recording README-table refreshes, 3 verification checklists), presentation/ (3 single-file HTML decks), and a literal '!' directory of badge/image assets. Claude Code config under .claude/: settings.json, agents/ (11, 5 under workflows/best-practice/), commands/ (10, 8 under workflows/), skills/ (7 SKILL.md: agent-browser, presentation-structure, presentation-styling, vibe-to-agentic-framework, time-skill, weather-fetcher, weather-svg-creator), rules/ (2, both with paths: frontmatter), hooks/ (scripts/hooks.py, config/hooks-config.json, 74 mp3/wav sounds), agent-memory/weather-agent/. Codex config under .codex/ (config.toml, hooks.json, hooks/ with 16 sound files). Two more SKILL.md files live in agent-teams/.claude/skills/ (time-fetcher, time-svg-creator), for 9 SKILL.md in total. None of the skills covers general engineering or security procedures; frontmatter in all 9 uses only name, description, user-invocable, allowed-tools.

code.tests_and_ci: Test frameworks: none. Test files: 0 (no file matching *test* or *spec* anywhere). CI: none - .github/ holds only FUNDING.yml, no workflows. code.dependencies: No dependency manifests or lockfiles (no package.json, pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod). Direct third-party Python packages: 0 (hook scripts import only stdlib plus optional Windows-only winsound: .claude/hooks/scripts/hooks.py:15-27, .codex/hooks/scripts/hooks.py:20-31); runtime needs python3, `which` and one audio player (afplay, paplay, aplay, ffplay or mpg123). .mcp.json declares 3 npm packages run via npx -y: @playwright/mcp@0.0.70, @upstash/context7-mcp@2.1.8, deepwiki-mcp@0.0.6 (.mcp.json:3-23). risks: Scope: the repo is self-described reference material, not a skills package (README.md:507; CLAUDE.md:7). No plugin/marketplace manifest, installer or AGENTS.md exists; the 9 SKILL.md files are weather/time/presentation/browser-CLI demos (.claude/skills/, agent-teams/.claude/skills/) and none is a general engineering or security procedure. 'code-review' and 'security-review' appear only as Anthropic-bundled skills documented in best-practice/claude-skills.md:48,63, not shipped here.

Codex coverage is thin: .codex/ holds only config.toml, hooks.json and a sound-playing hook (.codex/hooks.json:1-101); no Codex skills, AGENTS.md or instruction files, and Codex best-practice/hooks content lives in separate repositories (README.md:547-554) that are not part of this checkout.

Committed defaults are very permissive and author-specific: .claude/settings.json:4-9 allow Edit/Write/Bash/any-domain WebFetch/WebSearch, :83 auto-approves all project MCP servers, :55-73 sets author-branded spinner verbs, tips and status line; .codex/config.toml:1-2 sets danger-full-access with approval never; .claude/agents/development-workflows-research-agent.md:19 uses bypassPermissions with Bash(*)/Write/Edit although described as read-only (:26). Copying these wholesale imports those defaults.

Agent/skill artifacts do not all match their own docs: agent files use an `allowedTools` frontmatter key (e.g. .claude/agents/weather-agent.md:4) that the repo's frontmatter table does not list (it documents `tools`/`disallowedTools`, best-practice/claude-subagents.md:23-24), while the prompt relies on it to exclude network tools (weather-agent.md:49); enforcement is not checkable here, and time-agent.md:4-15 grants Bash(*), Write, WebFetch(*) and mcp__* for a task that only runs `date`. The agent-browser skill links reference/template files that are absent (SKILL.md:194-217) and drives an external CLI documented nowhere else in the repo.

Runtime supply chain: .mcp.json:3-23 launches three third-party npm packages with `npx -y` (versions pinned, no lockfile or integrity data) and .claude/settings.json:83 auto-approves them; .claude/settings.json:14-17 pre-allows reddit-mcp-server and tavily-web-search tools that .mcp.json does not define.

Churn and drift: content is updated frequently (badges through 2026-10-01, README.md:4; best-practice/claude-skills.md:3). README tables of third-party repos are maintained by an LLM research command with documented unstable counts (changelog/skill-collections/changelog.md:857, :139) and internal mismatches (10 vs 11 vs 12 workflow repos; '83' vs 82 tips; stale implementation doc; HOOKS-README vs code). CLAUDE.md:86-88 tells Claude to treat this repo as authoritative over external docs, while its docs pin version-specific facts. No measurements of the project's own skills/rules/hooks are published; the only figures are quoted vendor/third-party numbers (see benchmarks).

No tests, CI, release process or security policy: .github/ has only FUNDING.yml; the documented test command (.codex/hooks/HOOKS-README.md:209) points to a nonexistent module; no tags are visible in this shallow single-branch clone (.git/packed-refs), so upstream releases cannot be ruled out.

Licensing/provenance: LICENSE is MIT with copyright 'Shayan Rais' (LICENSE:1-3) and is the only legal file (no NOTICE/third-party attribution file found by glob), while the tree also carries third-party-derived or generated content: ElevenLabs-generated audio (CLAUDE.md:41; .claude/hooks/HOOKS-README.md:173-175), summaries of others' posts and videos (README.md:139-140, 399-406; tips/, videos/) and logos under presentation/assets/logo/.

First, 'the only code is two hook scripts' leaves out inline slide-navigation JS in four HTML files (presentation/claude-code-best-practice/index.html:2692-2755, the two other presentation/*/index.html decks, and !/video-presentation-transcript/1-video-workflow.html:501-582).
